In detail

Floridsdorf's press coverage clusters heavily around the area of Floridsdorf railway station and the adjacent Wasserpark. In May 2025, two youths fired shots (from what turned out to be a blank-firing pistol) while chasing someone through the skatepark near the station, drawing a large WEGA response (ORF, 31 May 2025). In August 2025, a 33-year-old man was stabbed twice with life-threatening injuries near the Wasserpark in a dispute among people from the homeless community; a 19-year-old suspect was arrested days later (meinbezirk.at, Aug 2025). In November 2025 a 27-year-old was shot in both legs on Sandrockgasse by a 52-year-old acquaintance with legally owned firearms (ORF, 24 Nov 2025). Street-level drug dealing near the station continues to be an enforcement focus, with a task-force operation in December 2025 netting a 17-year-old dealer, three buyers, cash and roughly 400g of cocaine (vienna.at, Dec 2025). Away from this station/park cluster, no comparable pattern of incidents was found. Sources checked: wien.ORF.at, "Schüsse und Rufe in Skaterpark" (31 May 2025); meinbezirk.at, "Im Wasserpark Floridsdorf: Tatverdächtiger nach Mordversuch festgenommen" (Aug 2025); wien.ORF.at, "Ein Verletzter nach Schüssen in Floridsdorf" (24 Nov 2025); vienna.at, "Drogendealer in Wien-Floridsdorf auf frischer Tat ertappt" (4 Dec 2025).
